Extensions.File:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    One-time Windows laptop cleanup, based on UnattendedWinstall/Winhance.
.DESCRIPTION
    Runs during specialize, before regular user profiles are created.
    Removes only explicitly listed apps/capabilities and disables Recall.
    Seeds privacy and Explorer preferences in the default user profile.
    Does not install applications, register tasks or change Windows security,
    updates, power plans, services, hardware checks or camera/microphone access.
    Applications and developer tools are installed manually after Windows setup.
#>

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$LogPath = 'C:\ProgramData\Winhance\Unattend\Logs\Winhancements.txt'
$null = New-Item -Path (Split-Path $LogPath) -ItemType Directory -Force

function Write-Log {
    param([string]$Message)
    Add-Content -Path $LogPath -Value "[$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')] $Message" -Encoding UTF8
}

function Set-RegistryDword {
    param([string]$Path, [string]$Name, [int]$Value)
    $output = & reg.exe add $Path /v $Name /t REG_DWORD /d $Value /f 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not set $Path\${Name}: $output"
    }
    Write-Log "$Path\$Name = $Value"
}

Write-Log 'Starting one-time laptop setup.'

# Exact names only: preserve shared frameworks, Store, App Installer/WinGet,
# Terminal, Edge/WebView2, OneDrive, Camera, Outlook, Paint, Photos, Notepad,
# Calculator and Snipping Tool. Teams is removed for manual installation later.
$packages = @(
    'Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer'
    'Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal'
    'Microsoft.BingSearch'
    'Microsoft.BingNews'
    'Microsoft.BingWeather'
    'Clipchamp.Clipchamp'
    'Microsoft.WindowsAlarms'
    'Microsoft.549981C3F5F10'
    'Microsoft.GetHelp'
    'Microsoft.Windows.DevHome'
    'MicrosoftCorporationII.MicrosoftFamily'
    'microsoft.windowscommunicationsapps'
    'Microsoft.SkypeApp'
    'MSTeams'
    'Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub'
    'Microsoft.WindowsMaps'
    'Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub'
    'Microsoft.People'
    'Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop'
    'MicrosoftCorporationII.QuickAssist'
    'Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection'
    'Microsoft.GamingApp'
    'Microsoft.XboxApp'
    'Microsoft.XboxIdentityProvider'
    'Microsoft.XboxGameOverlay'
    'Microsoft.Xbox.TCUI'
    'Microsoft.XboxGamingOverlay'
    'Microsoft.ZuneMusic'
    'Microsoft.ZuneVideo'
    'Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder'
    'Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes'
    'Microsoft.Getstarted'
    'Microsoft.Todos'
    'Microsoft.YourPhone'
    'Microsoft.Copilot'
    'Microsoft.Windows.Ai.Copilot.Provider'
    'Microsoft.Copilot_8wekyb3d8bbwe'
    'Microsoft.Office.OneNote'
)

$allProvisioned = @(Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online)
$allInstalled = @(Get-AppxPackage -AllUsers)

# Deprovision first so removed apps are not installed for new profiles.
# No logon/startup removal task: manually installed apps remain installed.
foreach ($package in $packages) {
    foreach ($provisioned in @($allProvisioned | Where-Object DisplayName -eq $package)) {
        try {
            Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -PackageName $provisioned.PackageName | Out-Null
            Write-Log "Deprovisioned $($provisioned.PackageName)"
        } catch {
            Write-Log "ERROR deprovisioning ${package}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}
foreach ($package in $packages) {
    foreach ($installed in @($allInstalled | Where-Object Name -eq $package)) {
        try {
            Remove-AppxPackage -Package $installed.PackageFullName -AllUsers
            Write-Log "Removed $($installed.PackageFullName)"
        } catch {
            Write-Log "ERROR removing ${package}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

$capabilities = @(
    'Microsoft.Windows.PowerShell.ISE'
    'App.Support.QuickAssist'
    'App.StepsRecorder'
    'Microsoft.Windows.WordPad'
)
$allCapabilities = @(Get-WindowsCapability -Online)
foreach ($capability in $capabilities) {
    foreach ($installed in @($allCapabilities | Where-Object { $_.Name -like "$capability*" -and $_.State -eq 'Installed' })) {
        try {
            Remove-WindowsCapability -Online -Name $installed.Name | Out-Null
            Write-Log "Removed capability $($installed.Name)"
        } catch {
            Write-Log "ERROR removing capability ${capability}: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

# Retain the upstream standalone OneNote cleanup, but never run it again at logon.
foreach ($basePath in @('HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall', 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Uninstall')) {
    $keys = @(Get-ChildItem $basePath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -like 'OneNote*' })
    foreach ($key in $keys) {
        try {
            $uninstallString = (Get-ItemProperty $key.PSPath).UninstallString
            if (-not $uninstallString) { continue }
            $silent = if ($uninstallString -like '*OfficeClickToRun.exe*') { 'DisplayLevel=False' } else { '/silent' }
            if ($uninstallString -match '^"([^"]+)"(.*)$') {
                $process = Start-Process -FilePath $matches[1] -ArgumentList "$($matches[2].Trim()) $silent" -PassThru -Wait -NoNewWindow
            } else {
                $process = Start-Process -FilePath $uninstallString -ArgumentList $silent -PassThru -Wait -NoNewWindow
            }
            Write-Log "OneNote uninstall exited with code $($process.ExitCode)."
        } catch {
            Write-Log "ERROR removing standalone OneNote: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }
}

$recall = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
if ($recall -and $recall.State -eq 'Enabled') {
    try {
        Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Recall -NoRestart | Out-Null
        Write-Log 'Disabled Recall.'
    } catch {
        Write-Log "ERROR disabling Recall: $($_.Exception.Message)"
    }
}

# Targeted privacy/debloat settings only. Leave UAC, locking, encryption,
# work-account registration, maintenance, diagnostics and update policies alone.
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AdvertisingInfo' 'DisabledByGroupPolicy' 1
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' 'AllowCortana' 0
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' 'DisableSearchBoxSuggestions' 1
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Dsh' 'AllowNewsAndInterests' 0
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Feeds' 'EnableFeeds' 0
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' 'AllowGameDVR' 0
Set-RegistryDword 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' 'LongPathsEnabled' 1

# Seed new users without a SYSTEM logon task, token impersonation or forced reboot.
# Use reg.exe for this hive to avoid PowerShell registry handles blocking unload.
$defaultHive = 'HKU\UnattendedDefaultUser'
$output = & reg.exe load $defaultHive "$env:SystemDrive\Users\Default\NTUSER.DAT" 2>&1
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    throw "Could not load the default user hive: $output"
}
try {
    $contentDelivery = "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager"
    foreach ($name in @(
        'ContentDeliveryAllowed'
        'SubscribedContentEnabled'
        'SoftLandingEnabled'
        'OemPreInstalledAppsEnabled'
        'PreInstalledAppsEnabled'
        'PreInstalledAppsEverEnabled'
        'SilentInstalledAppsEnabled'
        'SystemPaneSuggestionsEnabled'
        'SubscribedContent-310093Enabled'
        'SubscribedContent-338388Enabled'
        'SubscribedContent-338389Enabled'
        'SubscribedContent-338393Enabled'
        'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled'
        'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled'
    )) {
        Set-RegistryDword $contentDelivery $name 0
    }
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\UserProfileEngagement" 'ScoobeSystemSettingEnabled' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo" 'Enabled' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Privacy" 'TailoredExperiencesWithDiagnosticDataEnabled' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\SearchSettings" 'IsDynamicSearchBoxEnabled' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer" 'DisableSearchBoxSuggestions' 1
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" 'ShowCopilotButton' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR" 'AppCaptureEnabled' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\System\GameConfigStore" 'GameDVR_Enabled' 0

    # Keep practical Explorer defaults, without replacing image associations,
    # disabling previews, hiding OneDrive status or changing accessibility settings.
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" 'HideFileExt' 0
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" 'Hidden' 1
    Set-RegistryDword "$defaultHive\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced" 'LaunchTo' 1
} finally {
    $output = & reg.exe unload $defaultHive 2>&1
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
        throw "Could not unload the default user hive: $output"
    }
}

Write-Log 'One-time laptop setup completed. Check this log for individual removal errors.'
